scope.paper_search_scope: exact filename not found in authorized worktree or supplied Codex attachments directory
scope.DMM_code_found_in: No DMM/onset module or DMM-to-Cell2Fire invocation found in inspected backend/, scripts/, docs/ paths.

implementation.decision_rule: AP_engine - max(AP_baseline_a, AP_baseline_b), WIN >= +0.05, LOSS <= -0.05, otherwise TIE; Brier does not affect call.
implementation.initial_condition: one prescribed ignition cell/member from fixed setup coordinate plus jitter; no observed perimeter is initialized
implementation.environment: WorldCover majority over 9 offsets per 30m cell; DEM bilinear sample and slope gradient; hourly cached ERA5-Land wind; T/RH not consumed by Cell2Fire S run
implementation.not_official_metric: ROC-AUC is not part of docs/simulation/PROTOCOL.md; a supplementary time/wind scoring script computes it when both classes exist.

reference_data_coverage.interpretation: VIIRS detections and source_file/platform/pass metadata do not establish that undetected cells were observable and clear. No absence-of-fire label can be assigned from a missing detection alone.
